description:
I’m abhishek, an engineering admission and career counsellor dedicated to helping students make informed decisions.
I guide students in selecting the right college and branch across Maharashtra, keeping CAP rounds, cutoffs, and future goals in mind.
My support includes detailed cutoff analysis, option filling strategies, and step-by-step CAP round guidance.
I focus on honest, practical, and student-friendly advice to simplify the admission process.
My goal is to help students approach their engineering journey with confidence and clarity
